blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Pretrained diffusion models provide powerful generative priors for extreme image compression, but their stochastic, iterative generation processes are not designed to decode compressed representations directly. We present PrismCodec, which recasts a pretrained Diffusion Transformer (DiT) as a bitstream-grounded one-step generative decoder. PrismCodec uses the decoded representation in two complementary roles: a projected codec state defines the starting state for generation, while hierarchical visual priors derived from the same decoded latent provide semantic and structural guidance. To bridge the gap between stochastic, iterative generation and deterministic one-step decoding, we develop a progressive adaptation strategy. We first learn codec-conditioned transport from a noisy neighborhood centered on the codec state, distill it into a one-step mapping, and finally anneal the source perturbation to zero during end-to-end optimization. The resulting decoder reconstructs deterministically from the received representation without additional conditioning bits. Across Kodak, CLIC, and DIV2K, PrismCodec consistently improves rate-perception performance over prior generative codecs, achieving BD-rate reductions of 70-75% in LPIPS and 75-81% in DISTS over StableCodec. Code will be released upon acceptance.
blocks.zh: 被预先训练的传播模型为极端图像压缩提供了强大的基因前传,但是它们的有花样的,迭代的生成过程并不是直接去解码被压缩的表示. 我们提出PrismCodec,它重塑了一种经过预先训练的分泌变形器(DiT),作为位流基的一阶分基因解码器. PrismCodec在两个互补角色中使用解码的表示:一个预测的编码状态定义了生成的起始状态,而由同一种解码后潜入的分级视觉前传则提供语义和结构指导. 为了弥合分层、迭代生成和确定性一步解码之间的差距,我们制定了渐进的适应战略。 我们首先从一个以解码器状态为中心的吵闹邻里 学习解码器条件的运输, 把它蒸馏成一个一步骤的映射, 最后在端到端优化时, 将源扰动到零。 由此产生的解码器在不增加附加条件位值的情况下,从收到的表示值中确定性地重建出. 在整个Kodak、CLIC和DIV2K地区,PrismCodec不断提高比以前基因编码的速率感知性能,使LPIPS的BD率降低70-75%,而DSTS的BD率降低75-81%。 守则一经接受就会公布。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: At ultra-low bitrates, learned codecs built on optimized transforms and entropy models [ 4 , 5 , 76 ] can preserve only limited visual evidence of the source image. Generative compression therefore relies on image generation priors to synthesize details that are not explicitly transmitted. Yet compression differs fundamentally from unconstrained generation: plausible content is insufficient if it is inconsistent with the evidence retained in the bitstream. A central challenge is therefore to exploit powerful generative priors while grounding reconstruction in this limited transmitted evidence.
blocks.zh: 在超低比特率时,基于优化变换和 en模型[4,5,76]所建的已学习到的可解码器只能保存有限的源图像视觉证据. 因此,基因压缩依赖于图像生成前缀来合成没有明确传输的细节. 然而压缩与不受限制的生成有着根本的不同:如果压缩内容与比特流中保留的证据不一致,那么压缩内容就不足了. 因此,一个中心挑战是利用强大的遗传学前科,同时将重建建立在这种有限传递的证据的基础之上。

blocks.en: Pretrained diffusion and flow models offer powerful visual priors [ 37 , 88 , 83 , 28 ] , but their generative processes are not naturally aligned with compression decoding. Existing methods expose image-specific compressed evidence to the generative decoder through different interfaces. OneDC [ 112 ] and DiT-IC [ 93 ] derive semantic guidance directly from compressed representations, while AEIC [ 123 ] removes the text-conditioning pathway and reconstructs from codec latents. NeFIC [ 17 ] and StableCodec [ 122 ] retain fixed text conditions but also inject image-specific information through a decoded anchor and a codec latent, respectively. Together, these approaches show that effective generative decoding depends on how transmitted visual evidence is exposed to the generator. Two questions nevertheless remain: how should that evidence determine both the generative starting state and the visual guidance, and how can a pretrained model built for stochastic, iterative generation be adapted to deterministic one-step decoding?
blocks.zh: 被预先训练的传播和流出模型提供了强大的视觉前传[37,88,83,28],但其基因过程并不自然地与压缩解码一致. 现有方法通过不同的界面将图像特异性的压缩证据暴露在基因解码器上. OneDC [112] 和 DiT-IC [93] 直接取自压缩表达式的语义指导,而AEIC [123] 则去除文本调理路径并重建从编码潜想. NeFIC [17]和StableCodec [122]保留了固定的文本条件,但也通过解码锚和编码潜伏分别注入了图像特定信息. 这些方法加在一起表明,有效的基因分解取决于传输的视觉证据如何暴露在生成器上. 然而,还有两个问题:这种证据应如何决定基因起始状态和视觉取向,以及如何使为分层、迭代生成而构建的预先训练的模型适应确定性的一步解码?

blocks.en: We introduce PrismCodec , which recasts a pretrained DiT as a compression decoder whose starting state and visual guidance are both derived from the bitstream. These two roles are complementary: the codec-centered state anchors generation in the transmitted representation, while the visual priors specify semantic content and spatial structure that should be preserved during reconstruction. Inspired by recent image-generation studies [ 94 , 31 ] , we combine semantic and structural visual priors through a shared visual-evidence pathway. A lightweight decoder renders the decoded codec features as an internal evidence image, providing a common image-domain interface through which pretrained visual encoders can interpret the same bitstream-derived evidence. DINOv3 [ 95 ] supplies multi-depth dense semantic features, which are delivered to successive DiT block groups through depth-matched cross-attention rather than collapsed into a single condition. This preserves complementary levels of visual abstraction across the pretrained representation hierarchy. In parallel, the diffusion-native VAE supplies a spatially aligned structural prior through the latent-input pathway. Both priors are computed entirely at the decoder and therefore require no additional conditioning bits.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Prism Cadec ,它将一个预先训练的DiT重制成一个压缩解码器,其起始状态和视觉取向都来源于比特流. 这两个角色是互补的:以代码为中心的状态锚地生成在传输的表示中,而视觉前传则指定了在重建中应当保存的语义内容和空间结构. 在最近图像生成研究[94,31]的启发下,我们通过共同的视觉证据途径,将语义和结构视觉前科结合起来. 轻量级解码器使已解码的代码特性成为了内部证据图像,提供了一个共同的图像域界面,预先训练的视觉编码器可以通过它来解释相同的比特流衍生出的证据. DINOv3 [95] 提供多深度的密集语义特征,这些特征通过深度相匹配的交叉意向来交付给相继的DiT块组,而不是倒塌成一个单一的条件. 这保留了整个预先训练的代表等级的视觉抽象的互补水平. 同时,扩散-内在的VAE通过潜在输入路径提供空间相通的结构。 这两个前科完全在解码器中计算,因此不需要附加条件位.

blocks.en: Visual conditioning alone, however, does not make a pretrained generator a practical compression decoder. Diffusion and flow models are typically trained to generate from stochastic sources through iterative transport, whereas practical compression typically favors deterministic reconstruction from a transmitted representation under a tight decoding budget. We therefore progressively reshape the generative process around the codec state. First, we learn conditional transport from a stochastic neighborhood centered on the codec representation to the clean generative latent, so that the learned trajectory is already grounded in transmitted evidence rather than generic noise. We then distill this codec-conditioned transport into a direct one-step mapping. Finally, during end-to-end compression training, we gradually contract the stochastic source distribution onto the deterministic codec state. This annealing avoids an abrupt shift from the stochastic source used for flow learning and distillation to the deterministic input used at deployment, while allowing the codec and generative decoder to adapt jointly. Fig. 1 summarizes the resulting rate–perception performance. Across Kodak, CLIC, and DIV2K, PrismCodec achieves LPIPS and DISTS BD-rate reductions of approximately 70 70 – 75 % 75\% and 75 75 – 81 % 81\% , respectively, over StableCodec. blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Generative Image Compression. Generative codecs use learned priors to recover plausible content at very low bitrates. Adversarial methods improve perceptual quality through distribution matching [ 74 , 78 ] , while conditional and residual diffusion reconstruct images from compressed representations [ 113 , 30 ] . Recent work increasingly adapts pretrained generative priors, making bitstream grounding and efficient decoding central design concerns.
blocks.zh: 基因图像压缩. 基因解码器使用所学到的前科,以非常低的比特率来恢复可信的内容. 反常方法通过配给[74,78]来提高知觉质量,而有条件和残留的传播则通过压缩表示重建图像[113,30]. 近期的工作越来越多地适应了预先训练的基因前科,使比特流搁浅和高效地解码中心设计问题.

blocks.en: Bitstream Grounding and One-Step Adaptation. Pretrained-prior codecs expose transmitted evidence through different conditioning interfaces to guide reconstruction [ 122 , 17 , 18 ] . StableCodec combines a codec latent with structural correction under fixed text conditioning. OneDC [ 112 ] derives tokenizer-supervised semantic tokens from the hyperprior, DiT-IC [ 93 ] uses text-aligned compressed features, and AEIC [ 123 ] removes cross-attention. PrismCodec instead separates bitstream-derived evidence into two roles: a codec state determines the generative source, while an evidence image provides hierarchical semantic and diffusion-native structural guidance through complementary pretrained encoders and separate DiT conditioning interfaces.

Stage I learns conditional transport from a stochastic neighborhood centered on the codec state, grounding the generative trajectory in transmitted evidence. Stage III then contracts the remaining source randomness while jointly optimizing the codec and generator, continuously aligning the training-time source with the deterministic codec state used at deployment. blocks.en: 3.4 Learning a One-Step Generative Decoder
blocks.zh: 3.4 学习一阶梯化解码器

blocks.en: The pretrained generator and the deployed codec differ along two coupled axes: the former starts from a stochastic source and follows iterative transport, whereas the latter must start from a bitstream-determined state and decode in one deterministic step. Rather than imposing both changes at once, we adapt the generative process progressively. Stage I re-centers the source on the codec state while retaining stochasticity for flow learning; Stage II distills the resulting codec-conditioned transport into a one-step map; and Stage III contracts the remaining source randomness while jointly adapting the complete compression system to its deployed deterministic input.
blocks.zh: 预先训练的生成器和所部署的编码器在两个相接的轴上有所不同:前者起自分层源并遵循迭接传输,而后者则必须从比特流定态起步并分出一个定序步骤来解码. 我们不是一并强加两种变化,而是逐步调整基因过程。 第一阶段将源重置在可编码状态上,同时保留流相学习的分色; 第二阶段将由此产生的可编码条件传输分解为一阶图; 第三阶段将剩余源随机性收录,同时联合调整完整的压缩系统,使其适应所部署的可确定性输入.

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Quantitative Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.2.1 定量评价

blocks.en: The main comparison tests whether grounding both the generative source and visual guidance in the received bitstream translates into a better rate–perception tradeoff without systematically sacrificing source fidelity. Fig. 4 reports the rate–distortion and rate–perception curves in the ultra-low-bitrate regime, while Table 1 summarizes BD-rates relative to StableCodec.
blocks.zh: 主要的比较检验是在接收到的比特流中将基因源和视觉取向都打下基础是否转化为更好的率 - 认知取舍而不系统性地牺牲源的忠诚。 图4报告了超低比特率制度中的速率-扭曲率和率-感知率曲线,而表1则概述了相对于StableCodec的BD率.

blocks.en: Across all three datasets, PrismCodec shifts the LPIPS and DISTS curves favorably relative to prior generative codecs. On CLIC2020, it reduces bitrate relative to StableCodec by 71.46% at matched LPIPS and 77.08% at matched DISTS; the corresponding savings on DIV2K are 69.54% and 74.64%. The same operating points also yield FID-based savings of 30.63% and 46.96% on CLIC2020 and DIV2K, respectively, indicating that the gains in paired perceptual fidelity are accompanied by improved distributional realism. Appendix D provides complementary KID comparisons.
blocks.zh: 在所有三个数据集中,PrismCodec比起之前的基因解码器,对LPIPS和DISTS曲线进行偏好转移. 在CLIC2020上,比起StableCodec,比对LPIPS降低71.46%,比对DSTS降低77.08%;DIV2K的相应节省为69.54%和74.64%. 同样的操作点在CLIC2020和DIV2K上分别产生30.63%和46.96%的FID节余,表明配对知觉忠诚度的提高伴随着分配现实主义的改善. 附 录 D提供了互补的KID比较.

blocks.en: The perceptual gains do not come with a systematic loss in distortion performance. PrismCodec achieves PSNR-based bitrate savings of 5.82%, 30.45%, and 17.21% on Kodak, CLIC2020, and DIV2K, respectively. MS-SSIM remains close to StableCodec, with a 0.40% bitrate increase on Kodak and reductions of 1.48% and 0.90% on CLIC2020 and DIV2K. Taken together, these results support the central premise of PrismCodec: bitstream-grounded generation can improve perceptual reconstruction while retaining source-dependent fidelity.
blocks.zh: 知觉收益不会伴随着系统失真。 PrismCodec在Kodak, CLIC2020和DIV2K上分别实现了5.82%,30.45%和17.21%的基于PSNR的比特率节约. MS-SSIM仍然接近"稳定Codec",Kodak的比特率上升了0.40%,CLIC2020和DIV2K的比特率分别下降了1.48%和0.90%. 综合起来,这些结果支持了PrismCodec的核心前提:以位流为基础的生成可以改善知觉重建,同时保留依赖源的忠诚.

blocks.en: Fig. 5 examines whether the quantitative gains correspond to source-specific visual details rather than only aggregate metric improvements. At lower bitrates than the compared baselines, PrismCodec better preserves plate lettering (DIV2K 0847), leaf-tip contours and serrations (DIV2K 0857), and the fox’s eye, nose, and fur patterns (DIV2K 0862), whereas several baselines smooth or alter these details. blocks.zh: 4.4 阅读研究

blocks.en: We organize the ablations around the three claims underlying PrismCodec: (i) semantic and structural visual priors provide complementary guidance, with multi-depth semantics contributing beyond a single representation level; (ii) transmitted evidence should determine the generative source as well as its conditions; and (iii) explicit one-step distillation and subsequent source contraction are both important for adapting stochastic generation to deterministic decoding. All results report LPIPS- and DISTS-based BD-rate (%) on DIV2K relative to StableCodec. Each variant trains its own high-rate model and uses matched fine-tuning schedules to obtain the five rate points in Sec. 4.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们围绕棱镜科德克的三项主张进行整理:(一) 语义和结构视觉前科提供补充指导,多深度语义的贡献超过单一的表述水平;(二) 传递的证据应确定基因来源及其条件;(三) 明确的一阶分馏和随后的源收缩,对于使分层分层生成适应确定分层分层分解的重要性。 所有结果都报告DIV2K相对于StableCodec的LPIPS-和DISTS-基于BD-率(%). 每个变体都训练自己的高分模型,并使用相匹配的微调时间表来得到Sec 4.1中的五个分.

blocks.en: Table 4 separates two aspects of the proposed conditioning design. First, Single semantic depth repeats the final selected DINOv3 layer across all four DiT groups, increasing LPIPS- and DISTS-based BD-rate by 9.90 and 6.27 percentage points relative to the full model. This isolates the benefit of preserving multiple representation depths rather than collapsing semantic guidance to one level. Second, Structural only removes semantic guidance and increases the two BD-rates by 17.87 and 16.32 points, while Semantic only removes structural input conditioning and increases them by 26.65 and 27.40 points. The degradation in both single-branch variants supports the complementary roles of dense semantic guidance and diffusion-native structural guidance.

blocks.en: With both priors retained, Zero-centered noise replaces the codec-centered source with a Gaussian-noise starting state and performs worse than both the stochastic codec-centered variant ( w/o annealing ) and the full model (Table 4 ). Thus, the gain from 𝐳 c \mathbf{z}_{c} is not merely duplicated by the conditioning paths: exposing the bitstream through the generative source provides an additional and complementary form of grounding.

blocks.en: Table 4 evaluates the two transitions from the Stage-I iterative flow to deterministic one-step decoding. w/o annealing keeps ρ = 1 \rho=1 through Stage III and inference, using 𝐳 c + 0.3 ​ ϵ \mathbf{z}_{c}+0.3\boldsymbol{\epsilon} as the source, and increases LPIPS- and DISTS-based BD-rates by 14.52 and 20.23 points. This shows that the stochastic distilled source should be contracted to the deterministic codec state before deployment. w/o distillation skips Stage II and directly fine-tunes the Stage-I model with the full model’s annealing schedule, increasing the two BD-rates by 14.80 and 16.60 points. Together, these results support both flow-map distillation and source-noise annealing in the transition to deterministic one-step decoding.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented PrismCodec, which recasts a pretrained DiT as a bitstream-grounded one-step decoder for extreme image compression. The compressed representation determines both the generative starting state and hierarchical semantic and structural guidance. Through codec-centered flow adaptation, flow-map distillation, and source-noise annealing, PrismCodecprogressively transforms stochastic iterative generation into deterministic one-step decoding. The resulting model reconstructs directly from the received bitstream without additional conditioning bits, yielding an efficient and effective rate–perception tradeoff.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了PrismCodec,它将一个预先训练的DiT重制成一个位流基的单步解码器,用于极端的图像压缩. 压缩表达法既决定了基因的起始状态,也决定了等级语义和结构指导. 通过以编码为主的流调,流相图分馏,和源噪声取出取出取出,棱晶分解递增将分解迭代生成转化为定型一步分解. 由此产生的模型直接从接收到的比特流中重建,没有附加条件比特,从而产生高效有效的率-感知取舍.

Learned codecs have advanced through stronger entropy models [ 75 , 34 , 35 , 85 , 47 , 46 , 19 , 22 ] ,

and specialized, scalable, or distilled designs for efficiency [ 127 , 103 , 105 , 70 , 61 , 62 , 14 , 58 , 124 , 65 ] .
These approaches improve the coded representation itself; PrismCodec instead

blocks.en:
Generative codecs introduce learned priors to recover visually plausible
content at low rates. Existing families use adversarial priors [ 32 , 3 , 74 , 78 , 2 , 50 , 41 ] ,
discrete representations [ 101 , 27 , 25 , 73 , 110 , 42 ] ,
or complementary representations [ 71 , 111 , 126 , 66 ] ; related work also studies
bitrate control, progressive decoding, and rate–distortion-optimized
quantization [ 56 , 125 , 9 , 45 ] .

低速率内容。 现有家庭采用对抗前科[32、3、74、78、2、50、41],
[101、27、25、73、110、42],
或补充陈述[71、111、126、66];相关工作也开展研究

量化[56,125,9,45].

blocks.en:
Diffusion-based codecs reconstruct from compressed information through
conditional denoising [ 98 , 113 , 38 ] , residual generation [ 30 , 64 ] , or pretrained generative priors [ 84 , 8 , 86 , 48 ] . Other methods learn
latent guidance and reconstruction corrections [ 63 , 72 , 107 , 109 , 49 , 11 ] ,
or use frozen priors for zero-shot coding [ 102 , 108 , 26 , 80 , 100 ] ;
recent work further connects diffusion noise with quantization [ 87 , 23 ] . CoD pretrains diffusion specifically
for compression [ 44 ] , and CoD-Lite combines this with a
lightweight one-step convolutional decoder [ 43 ] .

blocks.en: A.3 Fixed Text Conditions

blocks.en:
StableCodec [ 122 ] adapts SD-Turbo with a fixed prompt and
a codec-produced latent input. Its auxiliary encoder supplies source
features during compression, and an auxiliary decoder predicts a structural
residual that is added after denoising and before VAE decoding. The fixed
prompt therefore coexists with substantial image-specific guidance.
PrismCodec separates the same broad grounding problem into distinct roles:
a codec-centered source determines where generation starts, while a frozen
VAE latent and multi-depth visual tokens provide structural and semantic
guidance through separate DiT interfaces. StableCodec also tightens the rate
penalty during training; PrismCodec’s source contraction instead changes the
generator’s input distribution as it approaches deterministic deployment.

OneDC [ 112 ] decodes a semantic token sequence from the quantized
hyperprior and uses it as cross-attention context. A pretrained generative
tokenizer supplies training labels through an auxiliary prediction task;
the tokenizer and predictor are unnecessary at inference. The resulting
hyperprior tokens retain spatial locality. PrismCodec instead computes semantic conditions from an evidence image at
decoding time, preserves patch-token sets from multiple pretrained depths,
and assigns them to successive DiT block groups. This makes the semantic
hierarchy an explicit inference-time condition. OneDC additionally uses
diffusion distillation for perceptual refinement; its tokenizer supervision
and refinement therefore address different roles from PrismCodec’s
Stage-II flow-map distillation.

DiT-IC [ 93 ] projects compressed features into the text
conditioning space and uses contrastive alignment with text embeddings
during training; inference uses the latent condition alone. Its adaptation
also includes a variance-derived spatial pseudo-timestep and self-distillation
that aligns reconstructed latents with frozen encoder outputs.
PrismCodec preserves multiple visual representation depths and adds a
separate diffusion-native VAE structural condition. Its one-step adaptation
also follows a different path: Stage I first learns continuous conditional
transport around the codec state, and Stage II distills the resulting
finite-time map. The source perturbation scale therefore defines a Gaussian
neighborhood of the transmitted codec state, whereas DiT-IC’s pseudo-timestep
controls spatially varying reconstruction strength.

blocks.en: A.5 Removing the Cross-Attention Pathway: AEIC
blocks.zh: A.5. 消除交叉关注途径:AEIC

blocks.en:
AEIC [ 123 ] simplifies the SD-Turbo denoiser by removing the
text encoder, timestep embeddings, and cross-attention layers. Its codec
synthesis transform produces both a denoising input and a structural
residual, so reconstruction still depends on image-specific compressed
information. Dual-side feature distillation transfers knowledge from a
moderate-encoder model to shallow-encoder variants. This targets encoder
efficiency and feature preservation. PrismCodec retains explicit visual cross-attention and adapts a
time-dependent conditional flow before distilling its map in Stage II.
The two uses of distillation therefore solve different problems: AEIC
targets encoder efficiency and feature transfer, whereas PrismCodec
compresses an already bitstream-grounded generative transport into one step.

blocks.en: A.6 Auxiliary Reconstruction Guidance: SODEC
blocks.zh: A.6 辅助重建指导:SODEC

blocks.en:
SODEC [ 18 ] is closely related to our use of a decoded
image as a visual interface. Its fidelity decoder reconstructs an auxiliary
image from compressed latents; a frozen ViT and a learned projection produce
a cross-attention condition. A separate transform supplies the
input to an SD2.1 U-Net evaluated at a fixed timestep. Both methods therefore derive visual guidance and the generative input from
the bitstream. PrismCodec further separates the conditioning role into two
pretrained representation spaces: semantic features remain distinct across
DINOv3 depths, while a diffusion-native VAE latent provides spatially aligned
structural guidance. The shared evidence image gives both encoders a common
image-domain view of the decoded evidence, and its auxiliary objective
includes paired semantic supervision ( Appendix C.2 ).

the stochastic source onto the deterministic codec state. SODEC’s rate
annealing changes the coding constraint; PrismCodec’s source-noise annealing
changes the generator’s input distribution.

blocks.en: A.7 Visual Priors and Progressive Flow Adaptation
blocks.zh: A.7 视觉前科和逐步流动适应

blocks.en:
PrismCodec’s semantic branch uses dense DINOv3 features [ 95 ] , while its structural branch uses the frozen
VAE encoder. Both are explicit
inference-time conditions derived from the same bitstream-dependent evidence
image. This differs from representation-alignment methods such as
REPA [ 117 ] , which use pretrained visual features as
training supervision for diffusion hidden states. More generally, using
semantic features in an auxiliary loss or discriminator is not equivalent
to supplying those features as decoder-side visual context.

blocks.en:
The adaptation axis is likewise compositional. Stage I builds on flow
matching and rectified flow [ 67 , 69 ] ;
Stage II uses established AYF-EMD distillation with an interval-average
velocity parameterization [ 89 , 29 ] .
PMRF [ 79 ] provides a related precedent for centering a
stochastic flow source on an informative deterministic estimate. PrismCodec
instead centers the source on an entropy-decoded codec state, without a
posterior-mean assumption or inherited PMRF optimality guarantee, and couples
that source with hierarchical visual conditions. Stage III then specializes
the distilled map to the deterministic codec state used at deployment
(Sections 3.4.1 – 3.4.3 ).

blocks.en: Appendix E Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录E 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en:
PrismCodecprioritizes rate–perception performance and effective adaptation
of a pretrained generative prior, rather than minimizing model size. As a
result, the current decoder remains relatively large compared with lightweight
compression models. Moreover, high-resolution images are decoded with
overlapping latent tiles to keep memory consumption manageable. These
computational costs accompany the substantial rate–perception gains obtained
by the current design, but leave clear opportunities for improving deployment
efficiency. Future work will explore more compact generative decoders and
architectures capable of processing full-resolution images directly without
tiled inference, while preserving the benefits of bitstream-grounded
one-step decoding.
